title: two_sum returns a wrong-order pair and self-pairs
description: two_sum(nums, target) must return the EARLIEST valid pair of indices (i, j), i < j, such that nums[i] + nums[j] == target. 'Earliest' means: minimize j first (the pair that completes as early as possible when scanning left to right), and for that j the smallest i. It currently allows pairing an element with itself (i == j). Fix it so the tests pass.
